confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a small coastal resort town, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season, location and property and is the least certain. Drink anchors are partly derived from the local beer relationship. The FX observation came from a search summary that cites the RBA homepage and was not opened directly, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Albanian coastal resort pricing for a small Ionian seaside town in peak July season, cross-checked against similar Greek mainland and Albanian Adriatic resort towns and adjusted to Albanian price levels. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor, at roughly 2x and 1.3x beer respectively, because direct knowledge of local drink prices is weaker.
